description: The transforms \(N^+,N^-\) are defined simultaneously on first-order formulas. On an atom \(A\), they give \(A,\neg A\); on \(\bot\), they give \(\bot,\top\). They send \(\varphi\to\psi\) to \(N^-(\varphi)\lor N^+(\psi)\) and \(N^+(\varphi)\land N^-(\psi)\), respectively, and send \(\forall u\,\theta\) to \(\forall u\,N^+(\theta)\) and \(\exists u\,N^-(\theta)\), respectively.
